message.reasoning_content:
I will review the VP's draft payment decision and object only to concrete problems based on the given criteria.

The invoice total is $9,975. The line items subtotal to $9,500 plus $475 tax. Both findings are informational and do not undermine the amount. The vendor is known and on file.

The risk memo contains a garbled statement about the vendor name matching an alias. The invoice name matches the master record exactly, not an alias.

I am now applying the five criteria for objections to the draft. The vendor master record supports the approval.

The draft correctly applies the under-$10,000 threshold. Both findings are properly addressed. The approval is appropriate.

The line item math checks out. The Net 30 payment terms are consistent with the due date. The invoice references PO-20260115, but no purchase order verification finding is present.

No concrete problems meet the objection criteria. The draft is sound. Verdict: accept with no objections.
